text:
Maya (CS): FYI KiteMetrics onboarding: noticing 95/98 latency tails ~1.1s on 512-token generation during spikes. Renewal flagged as medium risk unless we show a clear perf/cost plan this quarter.

Jordan L. (Infra): Can we try a measured quant-swap + session-affinity routing? My bet: compact-int4 for short replies + standard for long-form. Will need a quick canary and fail-safe.

Lina P. (ML): Agree. Suggest two-prong test: (A) compact-v3-int4 for requests < 600 tokens; (B) standard-v1 fallback. Measure token-cost delta and extraction fidelity on 50 labeled examples. Guardrails: extract-accuracy >= baseline-1.5% and no regression in top-3 intents.

Omar @KiteMetrics: Sounds reasonable. Main ask: minimal change to scoring pipeline and a rollback within 10min. Also need an exec-friendly graph of cost vs latency.

Maya (CS): We'll provide baseline exports by EOD. Proposed rollout: 7% canary for 36h, then ramp to 30% for 48h, auto-rollback on quality trip.

Jordan L. (Infra): I'll create a routing policy with session pinning to cached workers and a split rule based on token_count header. Draft routing rule below.

```yaml
routing_policy_id: rp_kitemetrics_0426
rules:
  - match: token_count <= 600
    route: redwood/compact-v3-int4
  - match: token_count > 600
    route: redwood/standard-v1
session_affinity: true
cache_prefixing: enabled
fallback_on_quality: redwood/standard-v1
```

Lina P. (ML): I'll run the evaluators overnight and post a small manual review list for edge cases (tables, numerics). Also enable KV-cache warmup and set batch_target=6, max_wait=12ms.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: account=kitemetrics, canary=7%, model=redwood/compact-v3-int4. Request ID: dq_8842.

Jordan L. (Infra): I'll wire up alerting for these signals: p95/p98/p99 latency, per-token cost, extraction_accuracy, error_rate. Any signal outside guardrails triggers a rollback and postmortem.

Maya (CS): Please include a short one-pager after canary with: latency deltas, per-token cost change, % of requests routed to compact, and any notable quality notes. Omar, can you confirm Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC ops window works?

Omar @KiteMetrics: That window is good. We prefer a warm-start run first, then canary. Keep us on the escalation thread if anything trips.

Lina P. (ML): Will share eval artifact link and a quick checklist for manual reviewers before Tue.

Jordan L. (Infra): I'll post the curl/deploy command when I schedule the canary.

Maya (CS): Great teamwork — goal is solid perf story before renewals review. :rocket:
